name: Assassin's Promise
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy and all your skills recharge if target foe dies.

name: Assassin's Remedy
description: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your next {{AttackSkills}} attack skills each remove one condition.

name: Assassin's Remedy (PvP)
description: Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Your next {{AttackSkills}} attack skills each remove one condition.

name: Assault Enchantments
description: Elite Skill. Removes all enchantments. Must follow a dual attack.

name: Augury of Death
description: Half Range Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Inflict Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWoundDuration}} seconds) and Shadow Step to target foe the next time damage would drop this foe's Health below 50%.

name: Aura of Displacement
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location.

name: Beguiling Haze
description: Elite Spell. You Shadow Step to this foe. Inflicts Dazed condition ({{DazedDuration}} seconds).

name: Black Lotus Strike
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy if target foe is hexed.

name: Black Mantis Thrust
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds) if target foe is hexed.

name: Black Spider Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds). Must strike a hexed foe.

name: Blades of Steel
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage (maximum 60) for each recharging dagger attack. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Blinding Powder
description: Spell. Inflicts Blindness condition ({{BlindDuration}} seconds) on target and adjacent foes. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Caltrops
description: Half Range Spell. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds) on target and adjacent foes.

name: Crippling Dagger
description: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals {{EarthDamage}} earth damage. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds) if target foe is moving.

name: Critical Agility
description: Enchantment Spell. (4 seconds plus 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes.) You attack 33% faster and gain +{{PlusArmorRating}} armor. Renewal: every time you land a critical hit.

name: Critical Defenses
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have a 75% chance to block. Renewal: every time you land a critical hit.

name: Critical Eye
description: Skill. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +{{PercentForCriticalHit}}% chance to land a critical hit. You gain 1 Energy whenever you land a critical hit.

name: Critical Strike
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{Damage}} damage. Automatic critical hit. You gain {{Energy}} Energy. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Dancing Daggers
description: Half Range Spell. Three projectiles: each deals {{EarthDamage}} earth damage. Counts as a lead attack.

name: Dark Apostasy
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your critical hits remove an enchantment. Removal cost: lose {{EnergyLoss}} Energy or Dark Apostasy ends.

name: Dark Escape
description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move 25% faster and take half damage. Ends if you hit with an attack.

name: Dark Prison
description: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 33% slower ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Dash
description: Stance. (3 seconds.) You move 50% faster.

name: Deadly Haste
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your half-ranged spells cast {{CastingPercent}}% faster and recharge {{RechargePercent}}% faster.

name: Deadly Paradox
description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your Assassin skills activate and recharge 33% faster. Disables your attack skills (10 seconds).

name: Death Blossom
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Also affects foes adjacent to target foe. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Death Blossom (PvP)
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Also affects foes adjacent to target foe. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Death's Charge
description: Spell. You Shadow Step to target foe. You are healed for {{Healing}} if this foe has more Health than you.

name: Death's Retreat
description: Spell. Gain {{HealthGain}} Health if you have less Health than target ally. Initial effect: Shadow Step to this ally. Cannot self-target.

name: Desperate Strike
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage if you have less than {{PercentHealth}}% Health.

name: Disrupting Dagger
description: Half Range Spell. Projectile: deals {{EarthDamage}} earth damage. Interrupts a skill.

name: Disrupting Stab
description: Lead Attack. Interrupts an action. If the interrupted action was a spell, it is disabled ({{DisabledDuration}} seconds).

name: Enduring Toxin
description: Hex Spell. (5 seconds.) Causes -{{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration. Renewal: if the target foe is moving when this hex ends.

name: Entangling Asp
description: Spell. Causes knock-down. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds). Must follow a lead attack.

name: Exhausting Assault
description: Dual Attack. Interrupts an action. Inflicts 10 Overcast if the interrupted action was a spell. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Expose Defenses
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} second[s].) Target foe cannot block your attacks.

name: Expunge Enchantments
description: Touch Skill. Removes one enchantment for each non-attack skill you have. All your non-attack skills are disabled ({{DisableDuration}} seconds).

name: Falling Lotus Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage; you gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy. No effect unless target foe is knocked-down.

name: Falling Spider
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Inflicts Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds). No effect unless target foe is knocked-down.

name: Feigned Neutrality
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +7 Health regeneration and +80 armor. Ends if you hit with an attack or use a skill.

name: Flashing Blades
description: Elite Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have 75% chance to block while attacking. Block effect: {{Damage}} damage to your attacker.

name: Fox Fangs
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Fox Fangs (PvP)
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Fox's Promise
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your dagger attacks are unblockable. Ends the next time you fail to hit.

name: Golden Fang Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Inflicts Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWoundDuration}} seconds) if you are enchanted. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Golden Fox Strike
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Unblockable if you are Enchanted.

name: Golden Lotus Strike
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy if you are enchanted.

name: Golden Phoenix Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage to target and deals {{PlusDamage}} damage to adjacent foes. Fails if you are not enchanted.

name: Golden Skull Strike
description: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Inflicts Dazed condition ({{DazedDuration}} seconds). No effect unless you are enchanted.

name: Heart of Shadow
description: Spell. You are healed for {{Healing}} and you Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

name: Hidden Caltrops
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes 50% slower movement. End effect: inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds). Your non-Assassin skills are disabled (10 seconds.)

name: Horns of the Ox
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Causes knock-down if the target foe is not adjacent to any of its allies. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Impale
description: Skill. Deals {{EarthDamage}} earth damage. Inflicts Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWoundDuration}} seconds). Must follow a dual attack.

name: Iron Palm
description: Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is hexed or has a condition. Counts as a lead attack.

name: Jagged Strike
description: Lead Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Jungle Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Deals +{{ConditionalDamage}} damage to target and adjacent foes if target foe is Crippled. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Leaping Mantis Sting
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds) if target foe is moving.

name: Lift Enchantment
description: Touch Skill. Removes one enchantment.No [sic] effect unless target foe is knocked-down.

name: Locust's Fury
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have +50% chance to double strike. No effect unless you are wielding daggers.

name: Lotus Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage; you gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Malicious Strike
description: Melee Attack. If target foe has a condition, this attack deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage and is a critical hit.

name: Mantis Touch
description: Spell. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds). This skill counts as an off-hand attack. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Mark of Death
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe receives 33% less from healing.

name: Mark of Insecurity
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes {{HealthDegeneration}} Health degeneration. Enchantments and stances expire {{EnchantmentAndStanceReductionPercent}}% faster on target foe. Disables your non-Assassin skills (10 seconds).

name: Mark of Instability
description: Hex Spell. (20 seconds.) Causes knock-down the next time you hit target foe with a dual attack.

name: Mirrored Stance
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You enter any stance used by target foe.

name: Moebius Strike
description: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Recharges all your other attack skills if target foe's Health is below 50%. Must follow a dual attack.

name: Nine Tail Strike
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Unblockable. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Palm Strike
description: Elite Touch Skill. Deals {{Damage}} damage and inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} second[s]). This skill counts as an off-hand attack.

name: Recall
description: Enchantment Spell. End effect: Shadow Step to target ally. Cannot self-target and disables all of your skills for 10 seconds when it ends.

name: Repeating Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. This skill has +15 second recharge time if it misses. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Return
description: Spell. Inflicts Crippled condition ({{CrippledDuration}} seconds) on all foes adjacent to you. You Shadow Step to target ally's location. Cannot self-target.

name: Sadist's Signet
description: Signet. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health for each condition on target foe.

name: Scorpion Wire
description: Half Range Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe and cause knock-down the next time this foe is more than 100' away from you.

name: Seeping Wound
description: Elite Half Range Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} second[s].) Target foe moves 33% slower. This foe takes {{Damage}} damage each second while suffering from a condition.

name: Shadow Fang
description: Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. End effect after 10 seconds: inflicts Deep Wound condition ({{DeepWoundDuration}} seconds); you return to your original location.

name: Shadow Form
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Enemy spells cannot target you. Gain 5 damage reduction for each Assassin enchantment on you. You cannot deal more than {{MaximumDamage}} damage with a single skill or attack.

name: Shadow Form (PvP)
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Hostile spells targeting you fail, and attacks against you miss. End effect: lose all but {{HealthAtEnd}} Health.

name: Shadow Meld
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target ally. End effect: return to your original location. Cannot self-target.

name: Shadow Prison
description: Elite Hex Spell. Shadow Step to target foe. This foe moves 66% slower ({{Duration}} seconds).

name: Shadow Refuge
description: Enchantment Spell. (6 seconds.) You have +{{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration. End effect: heals you for {{Healing}} if you are attacking.

name: Shadow Sanctuary
description: Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) You gain +{{HealthRegeneration}} Health regeneration and +40 armor. You are Blind (5 seconds).

name: Shadow Shroud
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.

name: Shadow Theft
description: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. For {{Duration}} seconds that foe's attributes are reduced by {{AttributeBonus}} and your attributes are increased by {{AttributeBonus}}. Counts as a Lead Attack. PvE Skill

name: Shadow Walk
description: Stance. (15 seconds.) Shadow Step to target foe. End effect: return to your original location. Disables your attack skills for 1 second. Disables your stances and enchantments for 10 seconds.

name: Shadow of Haste
description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You move 15% faster. End effect: return to your original location.

name: Shadowy Burden
description: Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe moves 25% slower and has 20 less armor against your attacks. Armor reduction only affects this foe while it has no other hexes.

name: Shameful Fear
description: Hex Spell. (10 seconds.) Target foe takes {{DamageWhileMoving}} damage each second while moving, but moves 10% faster.

name: Sharpen Daggers
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your dagger attacks inflict the Bleeding condition ({{BleedingDuration}} seconds).

name: Shattering Assault
description: Elite Dual Attack. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Removes one enchantment. Unblockable. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Shroud of Distress
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have {{HealthRegeneration}} health regeneration and a 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.

name: Shroud of Distress (PvP)
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You have 75% chance to block. No effect unless your Health is below 50%.

name: Shroud of Silence
description: Elite Touch Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} second[s].) Target foe cannot cast spells. Your spells are disabled for 15 seconds.

name: Signet of Deadly Corruption
description: Signet. Deals {{ArmorMinusIgnoringDamagePerCondition}} damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe.

name: Signet of Deadly Corruption (PvP)
description: Signet. Deals {{ArmorMinusIgnoringDamagePerCondition}} damage (maximum 130) for each condition on target foe. Must follow a dual attack.

name: Signet of Malice
description: Signet. You lose one condition for each condition on target foe.

name: Signet of Shadows
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage. Deals {{AdditionalDamage}} more damage if target foe is Blinded.

name: Signet of Toxic Shock
description: Signet. Deals {{Damage}} damage. No effect unless target foe is Poisoned

name: Signet of Twilight
description: Signet. Removes one enchantment for each hex on target foe.

name: Siphon Speed
description: Half Range Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe moves 33% slower and you move 33% faster. Recharges 50% faster if cast on a moving foe.

name: Siphon Strength
description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target foe deals -{{DamageReduction}} attack damage. You have +33% chance to land a critical hit on this foe.

name: Smoke Powder Defense
description: Stance. (8 seconds.) The next time you are struck, you take half damage and inflict Blindness condition ({{BlindDuration}} seconds) on adjacent foes.

name: Spirit Walk
description: Spell. Shadow Step to target Spirit. [sic]

name: Swap
description: Spell. You and target summoned creature Shadow Step to each other's locations.

name: Temple Strike
description: Elite Off-Hand Attack. Interrupts a spell. Inflicts Dazed and Blindness conditions ({{DazedAndBlindDuration}} seconds). Must follow a lead attack.

name: Trampling Ox
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage; causes knock-down if target foe is Crippled. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Twisting Fangs
description: Dual Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Inflicts Bleeding and Deep Wound conditions ({{BleedingAndDeepWoundDuration}} seconds). Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Unseen Fury
description: Stance. Inflicts Blindness condition on adjacent foes ({{BlindDuration}}). You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes for {{StanceDuration}} seconds.

name: Unseen Fury (PvP)
description: Stance. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You cannot be blocked by Blinded foes.

name: Unsuspecting Strike
description: Lead Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Deals {{PlusDamageGtPercentHealth}} more damage if target foe's Health is above 90%.

name: Vampiric Assault
description: Dual Attack. Steals {{LifeStealing}} Health if this attack hits. Must follow an off-hand attack.

name: Viper's Defense
description: Spell. Inflict Poisoned condition ({{PoisonDuration}} seconds) on all adjacent foes and Shadow Step to a nearby location directly away from your target.

name: Wastrel's Collapse
description: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. Causes knock-down if target foe is not using a skill. Disables your non-dagger attack skills (10 seconds).

name: Way of Perfection
description: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) Your critical hits heal you for {{HealthGain}}.

name: Way of the Assassin
description: Elite Stance. (20 seconds.) While wielding daggers, you attack {{AttackSpeedIncrease}}% faster and have +{{PlusCriticalHitChance}}% chance to land a critical hit.

name: Way of the Empty Palm
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your off-hand and dual attacks cost no Energy.

name: Way of the Fox
description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Your attacks are unblockable. Ends after {{SubsequentAttacks}} attack[s].

name: Way of the Lotus
description: Enchantment Spell. (20 seconds.) You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy the next time you hit with a dual attack.

name: Way of the Master
description: Enchantment Spell. (60 seconds.) While holding a non-dagger weapon, you have +{{AdditionalCritChancePercent}}% chance to land a critical hit.

name: Wild Strike
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Removes target foe's stance. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.

name: Wild Strike (PvP)
description: Off-Hand Attack. Deals +{{PlusDamage}} damage. Removes target foe's stance. Unblockable. Must follow a lead attack.
